page_title: LIL 1-1 NAN | Lille v Nantes 04/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' Antoine Kombouare has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Nantes) replacing Johann Lepenant.
90+2' Substitution. Matthis Abline leaves the pitch and is replaced by Nicolas Pallois (Nantes).
90+1' Remy Cabella (Lille) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
90+1' Half-chance! Remy Cabella (Lille) plays a pass into the box, but Anthony Lopes reacts well to snuff out the attack. The ball goes out of play. Lille are awarded a corner kick.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
88' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
87' Remy Cabella (Lille) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
86' Marcus Coco (Nantes) was too forceful with his tackle and Jeremie Pignard interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
86' Bruno Genesio has decided to substitute Aissa Mandi and he is replaced by Thomas Meunier (Lille).
85' Remy Cabella (Lille) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
83' Here comes a substitution. Ignatius Ganago is given a rest as he is replaced by Marcus Coco (Nantes).
81' Total attempts – 11:6. The number of shots on goal at present is 2:2.
77' Here is a change. Ngalayel Mukau is going off and Bruno Genesio gives the last tactical orders to Andre Gomes (Lille).
77' Substitution. Ismaily (Lille) has come on for Gabriel Gudmundsson.
77' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
76' Lille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
72' Jeremie Pignard shows a yellow card to Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) for his blatant foul.
72' Matthis Abline (Nantes) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
70' 1 - 1 Goal! Matthis Abline (Nantes) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Lucas Chevalier into right side of the goal.
69' Matthis Abline (Nantes) is going to take the penalty!
68' Bafode Diakite (Lille) jumps into a tackle and Jeremie Pignard signals a foul. The referee gives a penalty to Nantes!
67' The Nantes players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

65' Wasted opportunity! Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) will replace Pedro Chirivella.
63' A pass by Remy Cabella (Lille) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.

60' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Remy Cabella (Lille) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
58' Sorba Thomas (Nantes) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
57' Osame Sahraoui (Lille) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
53' The Lille players are exchanging some short passes.
50' The goal by Nantes won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
49' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Nantes players aren’t happy.
48' Goal - 1:1! Douglas Augusto laid the ball off to Ignatius Ganago (Nantes), who unleashed a strong shot from close range into the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Jeremie Pignard has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Neat passing move from Lille in order to create new attacking opportunities.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
42' Referee Jeremie Pignard points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) goes wild in celebration.
41' The Lille players halt their celebrations as referee Jeremie Pignard makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
40' 1 - 0 Goal! Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 1:0.
40' Remy Cabella (Lille) smashes the ball against the crossbar! What a chance.
39' Lille are ruled offside.
38' Referee Jeremie Pignard sees the trip by Johann Lepenant (Nantes) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
36' A pass from Remy Cabella (Lille) is intercepted by Anthony Lopes and the move breaks down.
35' The current number of corner kicks is 0:0.
34' Sorba Thomas (Nantes) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
33' Benjamin Andre (Lille) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul.

32' Aissa Mandi (Lille) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
29' Lille enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
28' Surely that's handball by one of the Nantes players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
27' Remy Cabella (Lille) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
26' Dangerous play by Sorba Thomas (Nantes). Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
21' A player from Lille commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
21' A pass by Remy Cabella (Lille) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
19' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lille.
16' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
15' The Lille players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up. The ball possession is 66:34.
12' A pass by Benjamin Andre (Lille) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
10' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo is substituted due to injury. Bruno Genesio gives a chance to Osame Sahraoui (Lille).
9' The game is interrupted now, Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
7' Remy Cabella (Lille) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
6' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) is able to continue to play.
5' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
4' Aissa Mandi (Lille) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
2' Aissa Mandi (Lille) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
2' It looks like Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) saw red with that tackle. Jeremie Pignard won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
1' Sorba Thomas (Nantes) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Nantes will have the kick-off.
Jeremie Pignard is introduced as the referee for today's match.
